metadata.source_organisation: FitzPatrick Institute of African Ornithology, University of Cape Town

historical_combination.reason: Dark-capped Bulbul / Common Bulbul taxonomic split. SABAP2's dominant historical dataset (Spp 545, 'Pycnonotus barbatus', Common_species='Dark-capped [x]', ~256k Cards nationally) and the newer post-split code (Spp 3036, 'Pycnonotus tricolor', Common_species='Dark-capped [x]', ~84 Cards nationally) share the IDENTICAL SABAP2 Common_species text 'Dark-capped [x]', confirming SABAP2 itself treats these as the same taxonomic lineage before/after the split. BirdNET V3's current acoustic labels already use 'Pycnonotus tricolor' / 'Dark-capped Bulbul' (see BirdNET+_V3.0-preview3.1_Global_11K_Labels.csv), but birdnet_taxonomy_0.3-Jul2026.csv (the reference taxonomy this build script joins against) has not yet adopted the split and only contains 'Pycnonotus barbatus'. A third SABAP2 code (Spp 11491, 'Pycnonotus barbatus', Common_species='Common') represents the taxonomically distinct current 'Common Bulbul' concept (not native to Southern Africa; ~1% reporting rate, consistent with vagrant/misidentification records) and is intentionally excluded from this combination -- it is also already dropped by the pipeline's existing duplicate-Genus+Species dedup (build_best_row_index), which keeps Spp 545's much larger Cards count over Spp 11491's.
historical_combination.excluded_reason: Represents the taxonomically distinct current 'Common Bulbul' (Pycnonotus barbatus sensu stricto) concept, not Dark-capped Bulbul -- must never be combined into this record.
historical_combination.monthly_rates_source: historical_only (raw monthly Records/Cards unavailable for exact recombination)
